description: This file defines the Goteo\Util\Form\Type\TypeaheadType class, which extends a form text type to provide a configurable 'typeahead' (autocomplete) input field in Symfony forms. It includes methods to configure options, build the form view, and specify the block prefix used in rendering templates.

classes.name: TypeaheadType
classes.description: A Symfony form type extension that provides a typeahead/autocomplete text input with specific configurable options.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the typeahead form field, including sources, labels, and behavior flags.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares the form view variables for rendering, setting attributes and default values related to the typeahead widget.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix string used for form theming templates.
